human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Project normalized decision evidence into generic DecisionRecord entries while preserving domain, source decision string, reason, subject, timestamp, and evidence refs. Existing GovernanceDecision and AuditResult models remain untouched. Dependency: 8012.project-validation-changes-runtime.
human_pressure.why_now: Run Reports need to explain why execution stopped without conflating runtime policy decisions with execution controller decisions or post-run audits.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.
red_lines: Do not modify existing decision enums.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.
